correctness.rationale: Companion matrix Q represents Fibonacci, its irreducible mod-p polynomial gives Q^p=-Q^{-1} for primes p≡2,3 mod5, and Q^{p²}=Q. Every binomial coefficient (2k choose j) for odd j is even, so the overall sign vanishes and the shift exponent reduces to (h−1)^{2k}. The fixed positive comparison Δ=F_{(h+1)^{2k}}−F_{(h−1)^{2k}} therefore obstructs every fixed M at all but finitely many inert primes, infinite by Dirichlet. Moss–Ward establishes sufficiency of M=5 at h=0; p=5 proves M must be divisible by five. Boundary h=1 and k≥1 handled; modular checker tests 1296+ instances.

The first natural deformation, translating the polynomial argument by any positive integer, is now completely classified for all even powers with an infinite supply of explicit prime-index obstructions, not just an isolated computation. This sharp rigidity boundary is structurally motivated by periodic-point Dold congruences; arbitrary polynomials and recurrences are not claimed.
